missions.title: A support case closure

missions.say: Read the passage as a professional briefing. Then summarise a clearer responsibility limit in 30 seconds, distinguishing the proposed action from the outcome that still needs to be verified.
missions.use: Use “The recommendation is to” in a concise professional recommendation about a clearer responsibility limit. State a condition or trade-off, then give an appropriate response to a follow-up question.
missions.recall: Hide the reading. Reconstruct the issue, recommendation, and qualification in a clearer responsibility limit. Reveal the text and check whether you represented both the reasoning and its limits accurately.
